notes: Quantities are per ONE standard adult portion; the app scales by everyone's portion sizes. In steps, {{300|ml}} is scaled too. Nutrition is calculated from ingredients. 'emergency' recipes use freezer and cupboard ingredients and take about 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Red lentil & spinach dhal
recipes.blurb: Warming, cheap, and properly filling with yoghurt and chapatis.

steps.t: Soften the onion in a little oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, grated ginger, cumin and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, the tomatoes and {{300|ml}} water. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and soft.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the salt, chilli and lemon go in. Stir a little spinach into the baby's so it wilts.
Stir the spinach, garam masala, chilli and lemon juice into the rest, then season with salt.
Serve with a big spoon of yoghurt and warm chapatis.

baby.smooth: Blend or mash the baby's portion until smooth and loosen it with their usual milk. Serve with a little plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Let it cool to warm and keep it thick. Offer chapati or toast fingers to scoop with, and a spoon of plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: Same as yours before the salt and chilli, with small torn pieces of chapati.

recipes.name: Black bean & sweet potato chilli
recipes.blurb: Smoky beans and sweet potato with rice, cheese and yoghurt.

steps.t: Fry the onion, pepper and sweet potato (in 1.5 cm cubes) in oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, smoked paprika and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the drained beans, the tomatoes and {{100|ml}} water. Simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is soft. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Add chilli and salt to taste. Serve over the rice with grated cheddar and yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Mash the beans and sweet potato smooth and stir in a little yoghurt.
baby.finger: Squash the beans lightly with a fork. Offer soft sweet potato cubes to pick up, sticky rice, and a pinch of cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli, with a little cheese on top.

recipes.name: Tofu & broccoli peanut noodles
recipes.blurb: Quick weeknight noodles with crispy tofu and a satay-style sauce. No coconut.

steps.t: Press the tofu dry and cut it into fingers. Fry in oil until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Cook the noodles, adding the broccoli and edamame for the last 3 minutes. Drain, keeping a mugful of the water.
Make the sauce: whisk the peanut butter with the grated garlic and ginger, lime juice and a splash of the noodle water.
Take the baby's portion out now: tofu fingers, soft broccoli and noodles with a little of the peanut sauce, before any soy sauce or chilli.
Add soy sauce and chilli to the rest of the sauce. Toss everything with the grated carrot and tofu.

baby.smooth: Blend the broccoli and a little tofu with a teaspoon of peanut sauce loosened with water.
baby.finger: Tofu fingers, broccoli florets cooked soft, squashed edamame, and short noodles. If peanut is new to them, try it earlier in the day on a separate occasion first.
baby.chopped: As yours before the soy and chilli, chopped small.

recipes.name: Lentil & mushroom bolognese
recipes.blurb: The family classic, with lentils and mushrooms instead of mince.

steps.t: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms (a food processor is quickest). Fry in oil for 10 minutes until soft and starting to brown.
Add the garlic, tomato purée and oregano and cook for 1 minute. Add the drained lentils, the tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta meanwhile.
Take the baby's sauce and pasta out now, before any salt or Henderson's.
Season the rest with salt, pepper and a dash of Henderson's. Serve with the hard cheese grated over.

baby.smooth: Blend the baby's sauce with a few pieces of soft pasta.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes like fusilli or penne, cooked soft and coated in sauce, with a little grated cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before seasoning, with the pasta cut small.

recipes.name: Paneer & pea curry
recipes.blurb: Mild tomato curry with soft paneer cubes, peas and basmati. No cream or coconut.

steps.t: Cube the paneer and fry it in oil until lightly golden, then set aside.
Fry the onion for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water. Simmer for 10 minutes. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Add the peas and paneer and simmer for 5 minutes. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the yoghurt.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli, garam masala heat and salt.
Add garam masala, chilli and salt to the rest. Scatter over the coriander.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with the peas and a little paneer.
baby.finger: Paneer cut into soft fingers, squashed peas, and rice they can grab in clumps.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, with the paneer chopped small.

recipes.name: Chickpea shakshuka with feta
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a spiced pepper and tomato sauce, with bread for dipping.

steps.t: Fry the onion and sliced pepper for 10 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Spoon the baby's sauce and one egg into a small ovenproof dish or a corner of the pan now, before any salt, chilli or feta.
Season the rest. Make wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook gently for 6–8 minutes. Crumble over the feta and serve with the bread.

baby.smooth: Cook the baby's egg until firm and mash it into the blended sauce.
baby.finger: Cook the baby's egg until set (British Lion eggs can be a little soft). Offer strips of egg, squashed chickpeas, and bread fingers to dip. No feta: it's salty.
baby.chopped: As yours, with no feta and the egg chopped.

recipes.name: Smoky chickpea & halloumi traybake
recipes.blurb: One tray of roast veg, chickpeas and halloumi, with tahini yoghurt.

steps.t: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Toss the chopped veg and drained chickpeas with oil, paprika and cumin. Roast for 20 minutes.
Take the baby's veg and chickpeas off the tray now, before the salt and halloumi go on.
Add the sliced halloumi and tomatoes to the tray, season, and roast for 12 minutes more.
Mix the yoghurt with the tahini, lemon juice and a splash of water. Serve with warm flatbreads.

baby.smooth: Mash the roast veg and chickpeas with plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Soft strips of roast pepper and courgette, squashed chickpeas, quartered cherry tomatoes, and flatbread fingers with plain yoghurt. No halloumi: it's very salty.
baby.chopped: As yours, with a little halloumi at most.

recipes.name: Mushroom & lentil cottage pie
recipes.blurb: A weekend bake. Make a big one, because it reheats brilliantly.

steps.t: Boil the peeled, chunked potatoes for 15–18 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the milk and butter, without salt.
Fry the onion, diced carrot and chopped mushrooms for 10 minutes. Stir in the tomato purée, the drained lentils and {{100|ml}} water. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon the baby's filling and some mash into a small dish now, before the stock, salt and Henderson's.
Add the stock, Henderson's and seasoning to the rest. Top with the mash and cheese, then bake at 200°C fan for 25 minutes. Serve with peas.

baby.smooth: Mash the baby's filling and potato together until smooth.
baby.finger: Soft forkfuls of filling and mash they can grab, with squashed peas.
baby.chopped: As yours before the stock, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: Pesto pasta with Quorn & spinach
recipes.blurb: A ten-minute rescue dinner from the freezer and cupboard.

steps.t: Boil the pasta. Add the Quorn pieces and peas for the last 5 minutes.
Drain, keeping a splash of the water, then stir the spinach through so it wilts.
Take the baby's portion out now, with just a little pesto (it's salty and has nuts in).
Stir the pesto and a splash of pasta water through the rest.

baby.smooth: Blend the pasta, peas and spinach with a little water and a tiny bit of pesto.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes, Quorn pieces cut into small strips, and squashed peas. If tree nuts are new to them, try pesto on its own earlier in the day first.
baby.chopped: As yours, with the Quorn chopped small and only a little pesto.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas & edamame
recipes.blurb: Microwave rice, frozen veg and eggs. On the table in 12 minutes.

steps.t: Fry the garlic in a little oil for 30 seconds. Add the frozen peas and edamame and cook for 3 minutes.
Squeeze the rice pouches to break them up, add them to the pan, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Push the rice to one side, scramble the beaten eggs in the gap, then mix through.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the soy sauce.
Season the rest with reduced-salt soy sauce.

baby.smooth: Blend the rice, peas and egg with a little water.
baby.finger: Clumps of rice, strips of well-cooked egg, and squashed peas and edamame.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Cheesy beans on toast with an egg
recipes.blurb: The classic emergency dinner, with enough protein to count.

steps.t: Warm the beans. Toast and butter the bread. Fry or poach the eggs.
Take the baby's portion out now: toast fingers, a spoonful of mashed beans and a well-cooked egg.
Pile the beans on the toast, grate the cheese over, and top with the egg.

baby.smooth: Mash a few beans with soft-cooked egg.
baby.finger: Toast fingers, a small spoonful of mashed beans (reduced-salt ones), and strips of egg cooked through. Go easy on the cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: 15-minute chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: Tins, frozen spinach and the spice rack. No curry paste, so no hidden coconut.

steps.t: Fry the garlic, cumin and turmeric in oil for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, the drained chickpeas and the frozen spinach.
Simmer for 8 minutes, squashing some of the chickpeas to thicken it. Heat the rice meanwhile.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli, garam masala and salt.
Season the rest with garam masala, chilli and salt. Serve with rice and a big spoon of yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend the curry with yoghurt until smooth.
baby.finger: Squashed chickpeas and spinach to scoop with rice, plus plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the chilli and salt.

recipes.name: Bean & cheese quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crispy wraps with smoky beans and melted cheese. Great for little hands.

steps.t: Mash the drained beans with the paprika and cumin.
Make the baby's quesadilla first: a thin layer of beans and a little cheese, with no chilli.
Add chilli to the rest of the beans. Spread them over half of each wrap, add the cheese, and fold.
Dry-fry for 2 minutes on each side until crisp. Cut into wedges and serve with yoghurt.

baby.finger: Quesadilla cut into finger strips once it's cooled, with yoghurt to dip.
baby.chopped: Small wedges of yours, without the chilli.
